description: This file defines a fragment (HomeFragment) for an Android smart home app UI, displaying a grid of devices with their status and handling user interactions.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a grid of smart home devices and their status, managing device setup and interaction.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML when the view is created.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views and sets up device data and RecyclerView after the fragment view has been created.

methods.name: setupDevices
methods.description: Creates a sample list of devices with predefined states for display.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures RecyclerView with a grid layout and adapter to display device cards.

methods.name: updateDeviceState
methods.description: Handles toggling of device state, currently a placeholder for sending commands.
